QUOTE: `python/src/entropic/_loader.py` `find()` searches, in order: `$ENTROPIC_LIB`, then `$ENTROPIC_HOME` (nested and flat layouts), then `~/.entropic/...`, then `ctypes.util.find_library("rentropic")`.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer gives env overrides, then the home directory, then the system library cache, but it ties the "nested and flat layouts" only to `$ENTROPIC_HOME`. The item requires two layouts tried per root, so the answer only partly matches.
